title: Dish
description: Food dish or menu item with name, description, cuisine type, price, ingredients list, and customer rating. Used for restaurant menus, food delivery apps, and culinary platforms.

name.description: Name of the dish (e.g., Margherita Pizza, Chicken Tikka Masala)

description.description: Detailed description of the dish, preparation method, and flavors

cuisine.description: Cuisine type or origin (e.g., Italian, Indian, Japanese, Mexican)

price.description: Price of the dish in the restaurant's currency

ingredients.description: List of main ingredients used in the dish

rating.description: Average customer rating, typically on a scale of 1-5
